name: Hospital Hole (Weeki Wachee River) via Rogers Park
area: Weeki Wachee / Spring Hill, Hernando County
coordinateNote: Entrance or parking coordinates from the November 12, 2026 gap review.
navigationAddress: Rogers Park, 7244 Shoal Line Boulevard, Spring Hill FL 34607
navigationDestination: Rogers Park, 7244 Shoal Line Blvd, Spring Hill, FL 34607
navigationNote: Drive to Rogers Park for the river launch; continue by paddle to Hospital Hole. Check the county advisory before entering the water.
experience: Launch at Rogers Park, a county beach park on the river, and paddle about 1,000 ft upstream around a few bends to the hole; you can also float over it at the end of the usual state-park-to-Rogers Park run. Rogers Park has its own swimming area, and the county says you might spot a manatee there.
cost: Rogers Park parking fee (amount not posted on the county page); launching your own kayak is otherwise free
access: Rogers Park is open 24/7, with a boat ramp and canoe launch. The county does not rent kayaks, so bring your own or rent upriver. No lifeguards. There is no land access to the hole, because the banks are private homes. It is a known cave-diving site, but there is no guided recreational option for him.

conditions.summary: Rogers Park: county water-quality advisory asks visitors to avoid water entry. Park hours were unaffected. A dated lifting notice was not found. The advisory names the park, not the offshore depth at Hospital Hole. The health department advised against all water activities at Rogers Park after its November 5 sample. September’s lifting notice predates the new advisory. Later clearance remains unverified.
